title: Concept: Node.js inspector debugging endpoint disclosed
description: The Node.js inspector publishes a target list containing webSocketDebuggerUrl. That URL accepts a debugger session on the live process, which reads and writes memory and evaluates arbitrary code with the service account's privileges. Exposure is equivalent to remote code execution.
applicability: Responses served by a Node.js process started with the inspector enabled on a reachable interface.
risk: The caller attaches a debugger to the production process, reads secrets from memory and executes arbitrary code in the service context.
